description: Files confirmed micro-entity accounts through the Companies House XML Gateway, over the deployed API, for companyNumber or, when clientId is given instead, for that practice client's own company number; returns the submission number. The company authentication code is not an argument: the user types it on the link request_companies_house_codes answers, and this call names that entry by codesEntryId. A single entry is used up by this call; a batch entry (clientIds) gives up only this clientId's codes, so run_for_clients can pass one codesEntryId for every client.

accountantsReport.description: Adds the accountants' report page and files the accounts as exempt from audit with an accountants' report

statement.description: The statement of the scope of the accountants' report

averageEmployees.description: The average number of employees in the period

balanceSheet.description: The seven FRS 105 lines for the current and prior year, as derive_micro_entity_accounts answers them

clientId.description: A practice client's id, to resolve companyNumber from the client row instead

codesEntryId.description: The entryId request_companies_house_codes answered, once the user has typed the codes on its link

director.description: The signing director and the date the accounts were approved

periodEnd.description: The accounting period's end date, YYYY-MM-DD

periodStart.description: The accounting period's start date, YYYY-MM-DD

registeredOffice.description: The registered office as address parts; taken from the company's Companies House record when left out

statementsAccepted.description: Every micro-entity exemption statement, confirmed true by the user before filing

name: submit_micro_entity_accounts_sandbox
title: Submit micro-entity accounts (sandbox)
